stemMd: A newspaper says that since a proposed rule has not eliminated all fraud in places using it, the rule cannot have reduced fraud at all. Which flaw is present?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It relies on the rule's popularity.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It compares fraud with an unrelated outcome.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It assumes fraud is always easy to detect.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It treats failure to eliminate a problem as evidence of failure to reduce it.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It assumes every country has identical laws.

explanationMd: Elimination and reduction are different standards. A measure may cut fraud substantially while leaving some cases. Evidence of remaining fraud cannot establish that the measure had no beneficial effect.

distractorRationale.c: Detection difficulty is not the stated inference.
distractorRationale.b: The same outcome is discussed throughout.
distractorRationale.e: No such universal assumption is necessary to the stated error.
